$comment: The models the split order names per caller kind when nobody configured any (issue #117). Owned by neither half: coai-mcp's CommandModels.Shipped and the extension's SHIPPED_COMMAND_MODELS each assert themselves against this file in their own suite. An empty name means the order says the generic words instead of naming a model. orderOpensWith is the start of every model order: GateCommands.ModelOrderMarker in the server and the bench's own copy in SettingsApplied are both held to it. splitOrderCarries is in every split order a first plan round gives, whatever its size (issue #131): GateCommands.GateOrderMarker and the bench's copy are held to it.
